description: This file is a PHP script for listing and managing RSS feeds within the vtiger CRM system. It handles displaying RSS feed forms, fetching RSS URLs, and rendering RSS content on the web UI.

classes.name: vtigerRSS
classes.description: A class managing RSS feed operations such as retrieving URLs and generating HTML content.

methods.name: getRssUrlfromId
methods.description: Fetches the RSS URL associated with a given record ID.

methods.name: setRSSUrl
methods.description: Sets or validates the RSS URL.

methods.name: getSelectedRssHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML content for a selected RSS feed.

methods.name: getStarredRssHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for starred RSS feeds.
